title: McLaren releases behind-the-scenes look at Lando Norris's hypercar test
extract: McLaren has released footage of Lando Norris completing 38 laps and 177km in the 2027 MCL-HY hypercar during a Portugal test, as the Woking team prepares for its World Endurance Championship programme.

title: WRC secures major three-year broadcast deal with BBC
extract: The World Rally Championship will return to the BBC from 2027 under a three-year UK broadcast deal covering selected live stages, the Power Stage and extended highlights, with Rally Scotland also receiving extensive live coverage.

title: Mercedes and Aston Martin go head-to-head in charity football match
extract: Employees from Aston Martin and Mercedes's Formula 1 teams met in their annual charity football match at St James Park in Brackley, raising money for local causes and Movember.

title: Charles Leclerc explains why he did not copy Lewis Hamilton's driving style
extract: Ferrari driver Charles Leclerc explains why adapting his driving to imitate Lewis Hamilton was not a viable answer to the difficulties he encountered with Ferrari's new 2026 car.

title: Ferrari 849 Testarossa meets one of Tasmania's great driving roads
extract: Top Gear takes Ferrari's 849 Testarossa to Tasmania's 99 Bends, combining the new hybrid Ferrari with an unusual road-trip setting and a close look at what makes the route special.

title: MotoGP plans two qualifying sessions each weekend
extract: MotoGP is considering separate qualifying sessions for the main race and sprint from next season, following the Formula 1 model and potentially changing how sprint grids are decided.

title: Z.ai disables coding-assistant features after security issue
extract: Chinese AI company Z.ai disabled some features of its coding assistant after users reported a security problem, highlighting the risks of increasingly capable agentic developer tools.

title: Vast Data launches confidential-computing environment for sensitive AI workloads
extract: Vast Data has introduced DataEnclave, a confidential-computing environment designed to keep sensitive workloads protected while organisations run advanced AI and data-processing applications.

title: Anthropic-linked CVEs pile up, but confirmed exploitation remains rare
extract: VulnCheck researchers report that hundreds of vulnerabilities associated with Anthropic's Project Glasswing have been tracked, while only one had confirmed exploitation in the wild at the time of their analysis.

title: GNU Radio joins open-source RAN foundation
extract: GNU Radio is joining the OCUDU Ecosystem Foundation as an official technical project, linking its software-defined-radio community with open-source RAN work spanning RF experimentation, emulation and future 5G-Advanced and 6G research.

title: NVIDIA Isaac ROS 5.0 adds agentic skills to its robotics stack
extract: NVIDIA has released Isaac ROS 5.0, adding new GPU-accelerated robotics capabilities including agentic skills and updated support for its open robotics software framework.

title: Claude Code adds AGENTS.md fallback for shared agent instructions
extract: Claude Code 2.1.277 adds native support for AGENTS.md when a CLAUDE.md file is not present, making it easier to share instruction files across projects that use multiple AI coding agents.

title: New compilation celebrates Matthew Smith's ZX Spectrum legacy
extract: Pixel Jockey is releasing a limited-edition collection of Matthew Smith's Styx, Manic Miner and Jet Set Willy, with newly produced packaging, artwork, a book and the first cassette release of Andre's Night Off.

title: First footage emerges of Railroad Tycoon's lost SNES port
extract: Previously unseen footage has surfaced of MicroProse's cancelled SNES and Super Famicom version of Railroad Tycoon, showing its menus, railway construction and business simulation systems decades after the project disappeared.

title: Amiga Unix gains 68040 and 68060 support
extract: A new patch extends Commodore's historic Amiga Unix System V port beyond its original 68020 and 68030 targets, allowing it to run on 68040 and 68060 processors.

title: Copper Showdown Editor 0.5.0 expands Amiga live-coding tools
extract: Copper Showdown Editor creates Amiga Copper lists in Lua and renders them through the vAmiga emulator; version 0.5.0 updates the editor, dependencies and audio handling.

title: Krill announce first album in a decade, Secret Language
extract: Reunited indie-rock band Krill have announced Secret Language, their first album in ten years, and shared the new single and video Dominate ahead of the November release.

title: Blue Bendy launch second album with Dragonslayer
extract: Blue Bendy have announced their second album, One Day This Will All Be Lore, and released the Arthurian-themed lead single Dragonslayer with a video directed by band member Olivia Morgan.

title: Blueneck finally release their long-awaited sixth album
extract: British post-rock band Blueneck have released Moonlighting after a decade-long journey marked by lineup changes, the pandemic and serious health problems, with the band describing it as their most personal record.

title: Madness's Take It or Leave It gets a new 4K restoration
extract: Madness's semi-fictional 1981 film Take It or Leave It is being rediscovered through a new 4K restoration, preserving the band's rough-edged portrait of their early years in north London.

title: U2 preview new song Silence ahead of their 50th anniversary
extract: U2 have shared the first seconds of their new song Silence as the band counts down to its 50th anniversary, offering another glimpse of the group's first new studio album in almost a decade.

title: Nivada Grenchen marks 100 years with F77 MKII stone dials
extract: Nivada Grenchen's centenary collection adds six stone dials to the F77 MKII, plus a 100-piece Ice Agate limited edition, all using the Swiss La Joux-Perret G101 automatic movement.

title: Grand Seiko introduces the unusual Arabic Blue limited edition
extract: Grand Seiko's SBGW325 Arabic Blue pairs a familiar 37mm manually wound dress-watch format with unusually bold Arabic numerals and the established 9S64 movement.

title: Girard-Perregaux creates two Laureato watches for Williams F1
extract: Girard-Perregaux has followed its new Williams Formula 1 partnership with a pair of Laureato Williams Edition watches, giving the integrated sports-watch design a distinctly motorsport-focused treatment.

title: FounderFest opens its 24-hour worldwide ordering window
extract: Time+Tide's seven music-inspired independent-watch collaborations became available through a worldwide 24-hour ordering window on September 22 after debuting at FounderFest in London, New York and Melbourne.

title: Barack Obama selects Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy for his new book podcast
extract: John le Carré's Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy has been selected by Barack Obama for A Great Book with Barack Obama, a new Audible series exploring six books that shaped his worldview.

title: China Miéville's 1,200-page The Rouse reviewed
extract: China Miéville's new speculative epic The Rouse combines a 1970s London family tragedy with Cold War military intrigue and an expansive supernatural second half.

title: Empire completes Sabaa Tahir's Heir duology
extract: Sabaa Tahir's Empire concludes the Heir fantasy duology, following a crumbling Martial Empire, an ancient threat and characters searching for allies and lost loved ones.

title: Fold Catastrophes collects new science fiction from Peter Watts
extract: Peter Watts's Fold Catastrophes collects science-fiction stories about brain-computer interfaces, ecological collapse, life inside stars and the limits of human control.

title: September 20–26 brings a new wave of fantasy and science-fiction releases
extract: A current genre-release roundup highlights September 22 books including Sabaa Tahir's Empire, Peter Watts's Fold Catastrophes and other new fantasy and science-fiction titles.

title: Sky and Now's September genre highlights include new science fiction and fantasy
extract: The latest Sky and Now selection includes science-fiction, fantasy, crime and historical dramas alongside returning genre favourites, providing a snapshot of the current UK streaming slate.

title: New and recent films arriving on streaming services this week
extract: CinemaBlend's latest streaming roundup covers new films arriving across Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max, Prime Video, Paramount+ and other services, including science-fiction, fantasy and genre titles.
